4367.title: Reasoning discovery deadline produces an actionable fallback
4367.rootCauseOneLine: The discovery deadline leaves models unprobed; catalog fallback advertises medium, which session selection applies as a real effort.
4367.proposedFix: Distinguish unknown reasoning support from an explicit effort and decide a bounded selected-model discovery strategy.
4367.caveats: Synthetic ACP bridge reproduction; no authenticated omp inventory or browser verification.
